evals.prompt: Add a callout to my note that flags a warning: 'Don't run migrations against production without a snapshot.'
evals.description: Simple callout insertion using Obsidian syntax.
expected_output_criteria: Uses the Obsidian `> [!warning]` callout syntax (or equivalent type like `> [!danger]`), not a plain blockquote
Callout has the warning text on a continuation `>` line
Does not invent non-standard callout types not supported by Obsidian
Suggests a sensible callout title if one is helpful, but does not add filler text
Markdown still renders cleanly outside Obsidian (graceful degradation)

evals.prompt: Convert my flat tag list at the top of the note into proper Obsidian frontmatter properties: tags=[infra, ops, postgres], priority=high, owner=[[Omkar]].
evals.description: Move tags into YAML frontmatter; respect Obsidian property types.
expected_output_criteria: Produces a valid `---` YAML frontmatter block at the top of the note
Tags are stored as a YAML list, not a comma-separated string
Owner is preserved as a wikilink-typed property (Obsidian `link` property), not stripped to plain text
Priority is a string property (not a tag or list)
Removes the original flat tag line from the body to avoid duplication

evals.prompt: Embed the diagram from architecture.canvas into my design doc, but only show the 'frontend' group, and embed the second paragraph of intro.md right below it.
evals.description: Hard: scoped canvas embed + heading/block reference embed.
expected_output_criteria: Uses the documented `![[architecture.canvas#frontend]]` syntax for the scoped canvas embed
Uses paragraph/block reference syntax (`![[intro#^block-id]]` or `![[intro#heading]]`) for the prose embed, not raw copy-paste
Distinguishes between heading (`#`) and block (`^`) references correctly based on what the user asked for
Does not embed the whole canvas or the whole intro.md by accident
Notes that block ids may need to be created in the source file if they don't exist yet
